Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorLoadLimiter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorLoadLimiter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CompressorLoadLimiter extends Object implements Serializable
Speed limiter that models how a power- or temperature-limited driver takes a compressor down in speed when the load rises, and how it lets the speed recover when the load falls.

A gas-turbine train at maximum gas-generator speed or exhaust temperature, or a variable-speed motor at its current limit, cannot deliver more shaft power. When the suction pressure rises, the gas density and the compressor power demand rise with it, and the driver responds by letting the shaft speed fall. The result is a speed that moves in anti-phase with the suction pressure, a compressor mass flow that no longer follows a pressure controller, and a flow stiffness (change of mass flow per change of suction pressure) that is a fraction of the fixed-speed value. This class reproduces that behaviour in a dynamic simulation so that the consequences for a pressure controller can be studied.

The speed command is the lowest of the master demand and the speed ceiling. If the required power exceeds the power limit, the speed is reduced at a rate proportional to the relative overload; otherwise it rises towards the command at the configured ramp rate, but only while the power headroom exceeds a small hysteresis so that the limiter does not chatter around the limit. 

 CompressorLoadLimiter lim = new CompressorLoadLimiter(1783.0, 22000.0);
 lim.setLimiterGain(400.0);
 double speed = lim.update(1783.0, currentSpeed, shaftPowerKW, dt);
 boolean limited = lim.isPowerLimited();

      public double update(double demandSpeed, double currentSpeed, double requiredPowerKW, double dt)
      Advances the limiter one time step.
      Parameters:
      demandSpeed - speed demanded by the master (pressure or flow) controller
      currentSpeed - present shaft speed
      requiredPowerKW - power demanded by the compressor at the present speed and suction conditions, in kW

      Returns:
      the new speed command after applying the ceiling and the power limit

    • update

      public double update(Compressor compressor, double demandSpeed, double dt)
      Advances the limiter for a compressor, using its speed, shaft power and driver model when present.

      If the compressor has a CompressorDriver, the driver power at the present speed is used as the limit (CompressorDriver.getMaxAvailablePowerAtSpeed(double)) and the required driver power includes the driver efficiency. Otherwise the limit given to the constructor and the shaft power are used.

      Parameters:
      compressor - compressor whose speed is limited
      demandSpeed - speed demanded by the master controller
      dt - time step in seconds
      Returns:
      the new speed command; the caller applies it with Compressor.setSpeed(double)
